annotations.title: utilpeek: cryptographically strong random numbers, bytes, UUIDs, dice rolls, picks and shuffles

description: utilpeek: Generate cryptographically strong random numbers, bytes, UUIDs, dice rolls, picks and shuffles. For UUIDs and ULIDs use generate_ids. Returns values from the OS CSPRNG (Python `secrets`): integers (uniform, inclusive range), floats in [min, max), 1-1,024 random bytes (hex or base64), UUID v4, dice rolls such as 3d6 or 2d10+3 with the total, picks from a list or a shuffle. Input: optional `kind`, `min` and `max`, `count`, `length` and `encoding`, `dice`, `items` and `unique`; an empty body gives one integer 0-100. Parameters that do not fit the kind, count over 1,000 or more than 1,000 items are a 422 before any payment (not charged). Nothing is stored or logged. Generate secret keys locally. Typically under 0.1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 utilpeek calls per IP per UTC day.

count.description: How many values (1-1000, default 1): int, float, uuid, pick.
count.title: Count

dice.description: dice: an expression such as 3d6, d20 or 2d10+3 (1-100 dice of 2-1000 sides, optional +/- modifier; default 1d6).
dice.title: Dice

items.description: pick / shuffle: a comma-separated list (at most 1,000 items of 200 characters; blanks are dropped).
items.title: Items

kind.description: int (default), float, bytes, uuid (v4), dice, pick or shuffle.
kind.title: Kind

length.description: bytes: how many random bytes (1-1024, default 16).
length.title: Length

max.description: int: highest value, inclusive (default 100). float: upper bound, exclusive (default 1); max must exceed min.
max.title: Max

min.description: int: lowest value, inclusive (default 0). float: lowest, inclusive (default 0).
min.title: Min

unique.description: pick: draw without replacement (count at most the number of items).
unique.title: Unique

name: generate_random

error.description: Only on an error result: an object {code, message}, or the reason string of an x402 PaymentRequired object.
